name: bootstrap
description: Agent skills for installing, customizing, and migrating Bootstrap 6 projects.

interface.shortDescription: Install, customize, and migrate Bootstrap 6 with agent skills
interface.longDescription:
Bootstrap is a CSS and JavaScript framework for building responsive interfaces. This plugin gives coding agents the Bootstrap 6 skills already in this repository.

Use it when installing Bootstrap 6 (CDN or package managers), wiring Vite, Webpack, Parcel, or npm-only setups, authoring component CSS and TypeScript, working with the color system or utility API, or migrating from Bootstrap 4 or 5 to Bootstrap 6.

Each skill walks through a concrete workflow with the same guidance as the Bootstrap docs guides — from project setup through migration checklists.
defaultPrompt: Set up Bootstrap 6 with Vite in this project
Migrate this Bootstrap 5 UI to Bootstrap 6
Add a custom Bootstrap component with Sass tokens and TypeScript
